pairs: Loquere ad omnem cœtum filiorum Israël, et dices ad eos:
Speak to the entire assembly of the sons of Israel,
Sancti estote, quia ego sanctus sum,
and you shall say to them: Be holy,
for I, the Lord your God, am holy.
Let each one fear his father
I am the Lord your God.
Do not be willing to convert to idols,
neither should you make molten gods for yourselves.
I am the Lord your God.
If you immolate a victim of peace offerings to the Lord,
so that he may be appeased,
eo die quo fuerit immolata, comedetis eam,
you shall eat it on the same day as when it was immolated,
quidquid autem residuum fuerit in diem tertium, igne comburetis.
Then whatever will remain on the third day you shall burn with fire.
Si quis post biduum comederit ex ea,
If anyone, after two days, will have eaten from it,
he shall be profane and guilty of impiety.
And he shall bear his iniquity,
for he has polluted what is holy to the Lord.
et peribit anima illa de populo suo.
And that soul shall perish from his people.
When you will have harvested the grain fields of your land,
non tondebis usque ad solum superficiem terræ,
you shall not cut it down to the surface of the land, even to the ground,
nor shall you gather the remaining ears of grain.
neque in vinea tua racemos et grana decidentia congregabis:
Neither shall you gather the clusters or individual grapes which fall down in your vineyard,
sed pauperibus et peregrinis carpenda dimittes.
but you shall leave them for paupers and travelers to take.
I am the Lord your God.
Neither shall anyone deceive his neighbor.
You shall not commit perjury in my name,
nor shall you pollute the name of your God.
Non facies calumniam proximo tuo nec vi opprimes eum.
You shall not slander your neighbor, nor shall you oppress him by violence.
Non morabitur opus mercenarii tui apud te usque mane.
The wages of a hired hand, you shall not delay with you until tomorrow.
You shall not speak evil of the deaf,
nor shall you place a stumbling block before the blind,
but you shall fear the Lord your God,
You shall not do what is unjust,
You shall not consider the reputation of the poor,
nor shall you honor the countenance of the powerful.
You shall not be a detractor,
nor a whisperer, among the people.
Non stabis contra sanguinem proximi tui.
You shall not stand against the blood of your neighbor.
Non oderis fratrem tuum in corde tuo,
You shall not hate your brother in your heart,
lest you have sin over him.
nec memor eris injuriæ civium tuorum.
neither should you be mindful of the injury of your fellow citizens.
You shall love your friend as yourself.
Leges meas custodite. Jumentum tuum non facies coire cum alterius generis animantibus.
Observe my laws. You shall not cause your cattle to breed with other kinds of animals.
Agrum tuum non seres diverso semine.
You shall not sow your field with diverse seeds.
Veste, quæ ex duobus texta est, non indueris.
You shall not be clothed with a garment which has been woven from two things.
If a man will have slept in sexual intercourse with a woman,
si dormierit cum muliere coitu seminis,
and who is also able to be married,
and yet he has not redeemed her with a price,
nor paid to set her free,
for she was not a free woman.
Pro delicto autem suo offeret Domino ad ostium tabernaculi testimonii arietem:
But, for his offense, he shall offer a ram to the Lord at the door of the tabernacle of the testimony.
And the priest shall pray for him,
et pro peccato ejus coram Domino,
and for his sin, before the Lord,
and he shall win his favor again for him,
and the sin shall be forgiven.
When you will have entered into the land,
et plantaveritis in ea ligna pomifera,
and will have planted in it fruit trees,
you shall take away their first-fruits;
the fruit that germinates shall be unclean to you,
neither shall you eat from these.
Quarto autem anno omnis fructus eorum sanctificabitur,
all their fruit shall be sanctified for the praise of the Lord.
And in the fifth year you shall eat the produce,
gathering the fruits which are brought forth.
I am the Lord your God.
You shall not eat with blood.
And you shall not cut the hair of your head circularly,
Et super mortuo non incidetis carnem vestram,
You shall not cut your flesh for the dead,
neque figuras aliquas aut stigmata facietis vobis.
and you shall not make other figures or marks on yourself.
ne contaminetur terra et impleatur piaculo.
lest the land be contaminated and filled with crimes.
and be apprehensive toward my Sanctuary.
Do not turn aside to astrologers,
so as to be polluted through them.
I am the Lord your God.
Rise up in the presence of a gray-haired head,
and honor the reputation of an elder,
and fear the Lord your God.
Si habitaverit advena in terra vestra,
If a newcomer lives in your land
sed sit inter vos quasi indigena,
but let him be among you like one native born.
And you shall love him as yourselves.
fuistis enim et vos advenæ in terra Ægypti.
For you were also newcomers in the land of Egypt.
I am the Lord your God.
Nolite facere iniquum aliquid in judicio,
Do not be willing to accomplish iniquity in judgment,
let the dry measure be just
and the liquid measure be equal.
I am the Lord your God,
qui eduxi vos de terra Ægypti.
who led you away from the land of Egypt.
